items.title: Amygdala vulnerability in Pick disease with discrete frontotemporal dementia syndromes.
items.authors: Rachel Keszycki; Allegra Kawles; Grace Minogue; Antonia Zouridakis; Alyssa Macomber; Caroline Nelson; Qinwen Mao; Rudolph J Castellani
items.abstract: Frontotemporal lobar degeneration with tauopathy (FTLD-tau) typically manifests as either behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) or primary progressive aphasia (PPA). Tau pathology in FTLD-tau is characterized by predominantly three-repeat (3R) tau, as in Pick disease (PiD), or four-repeat (4R) tau species of corticobasal degeneration (CBD) and progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP). FTLD-tau preferentially targets frontal and anterior temporal lobes, including the amygdala, contributing to severe neuropsychiatric symptoms. This study investigated whether bvFTD and PPA due to FTLD-tau exhibit distinct amygdalar histopathology and whether these patterns reflect their initially distinct clinical phenotypes, particularly in PiD. We examined 47 autopsy-confirmed FTLD-tau cases from the Northwestern Alzheimer's Disease Research Center Brain Bank using postmortem digital pathology analysis to quantify tau phosphorylation and HLA-DR immunoreactivity in the amygdala. In a subset of 19 PiD cases (10 bvFTD-PiD, 9 PPA-PiD), we assessed neuropsychiatric symptoms, tracked longitudinally using the Neuropsychiatric Inventory-Questionnaire (NPI-Q), and quantified neuronal and Pick body densities via unbiased stereology and neuronal sizes via digital pathology analysis. Across the FTLD-tau cohort, bvFTD exhibited greater amygdalar neuroinflammation than PPA, despite comparable tau burden. Interestingly, 3R cases also demonstrated higher levels of phosphorylated tau and MHC-II-positive microglia than 4R cases. In PiD, neuropsychiatric symptoms converged over time, with PPA cases evolving to show bvFTD-like symptoms with disease progression. BvFTD-PiD showed a trend toward greater MHC-II-positive microglia than PPA-PiD, despite similar neuronal size/density and Pick body burden. Increased HLA-DR immunoreactivity correlated positively with Pick body pathology. Neurons containing tau pathology (Pick cells) were notably larger than unaffected neurons, suggesting that early tau accumulation precedes overt neuronal degeneration. These findings underscore the potential role of neuroinflammation in shaping clinical phenotypes in FTLD and highlight the role of the amygdala in complex clinicopathologic relationships. Targeting neuroinflammatory processes may represent a viable therapeutic avenue for managing neuropsychiatric symptoms in tauopathies.

items.title: An oxidized ribonucleotide 8-oxoGTP drives neuroinflammation and accelerates cognitive decline.
items.authors: Jin Li; Zhen-He Wang; Jia-Xin Pan; Zhe-Li Jiang; Rui Li; Xu-Fan Gao; Gang Sheng; Zi-Hui Wang
items.abstract: Oxidative stress is a hallmark of aging and a key driver of neurodegenerative diseases. While much attention has been given to oxidative damage of macromolecules, the functional consequences of oxidizing the abundant nucleotide triphosphate (NTP) pool remain largely unknown. Here, we identify oxidized GTP (8-oxoGTP)-a major product of NTP oxidation-not as a mere marker of damage, but as an endogenous signaling molecule that drives microglial activation and neuroinflammation. 8-oxoGTP accumulated in the aging mouse brain, and its elevation was sufficient to induce synaptic dysfunction, tau hyperphosphorylation, neuronal loss, and cognitive decline. Mechanistically, 8-oxoGTP functioned as a potent activator of heterotrimeric G proteins, binding more strongly to Gα subunits than GTP itself, triggering Src kinase/MAPK/Akt/NF-κB signaling in microglia, leading to pro-inflammatory cytokine production, reactive oxygen species generation, and neurotoxicity. Pharmacological inhibition of Src family kinases rescued the neuroinflammatory and cognitive phenotypes induced by 8-oxoGTP. Our findings reveal a previously unrecognized mechanism linking nucleotide oxidation to age-associated neurodegenerative processes.

items.title_cn: 氧化核糖核苷酸 8-oxoGTP 会引发神经炎症并加速认知能力下降。
items.abstract_cn: 氧化应激是衰老的标志，也是神经退行性疾病的关键驱动因素。尽管人们对大分子的氧化损伤给予了很多关注，但氧化丰富的三磷酸核苷酸（NTP）池的功能后果仍然很大程度上未知。在这里，我们确定了氧化 GTP (8-oxoGTP)——NTP 氧化的主要产物——不仅仅是损伤标记，而是驱动小胶质细胞激活和神经炎症的内源信号分子。 8-oxoGTP 在衰老小鼠大脑中积累，其升高足以诱发突触功能障碍、tau 蛋白过度磷酸化、神经元损失和认知能力下降。从机制上讲，8-oxoGTP 作为异三聚体 G 蛋白的有效激活剂，与 Gα 亚基的结合比 GTP 本身更强，触发小胶质细胞中的 Src 激酶/MAPK/Akt/NF-κB 信号传导，导致促炎细胞因子的产生、活性氧的产生和神经毒性。 Src 家族激酶的药理学抑制可挽救 8-oxoGTP 诱导的神经炎症和认知表型。我们的研究结果揭示了一种以前未被认识的机制，将核苷酸氧化与年龄相关的神经退行性过程联系起来。

items.title: Brain-sensing synNotch-CAR T cells enable precise targeting and clearance of diffuse midline glioma in multiple preclinical models.
items.authors: Senthilnath Lakshmanachetty; Milos S Simic; Payal B Watchmaker; Robert Zhu; Takahide Nejo; Maggie Colton Cove; Jeffrey Haegelin; Haoyu Long
items.abstract: Diffuse midline glioma (DMG) is a lethal pediatric brain tumor with limited therapeutic options and a poor prognosis. The success of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy requires both improving T cell tumor infiltration and persistence and reducing the risk of on-target/off-tumor toxicity. Here, we adapted and advanced a brain-restricted CAR T cell platform previously validated in glioblastoma to address the anatomical and biological challenges of DMG. We engineered a T cell circuit in which a brain-specific synthetic Notch (synNotch) receptor recognizing brevican (BCAN) induced CAR expression against EphA2 or IL-13Rα2 ("B-SYNC"), thereby restricting CAR expression to the central nervous system (CNS). In immunodeficient DMG models, a single infusion of intravenous (iv) or intracerebroventricular (icv) B-SYNC circuit T cells led to tumor infiltration, sustained persistence, antitumor activity, and extended survival. An alternative BCAN-primed CAR targeting B7-H3 or IL-13Rα2 ("B-SYNC-B/I") similarly improved therapeutic efficacy when delivered intravenously. However, icv administration triggered fatal neurotoxicity because of low-level B7-H3 expression in nontumor CNS regions, indicating that rapid CNS exposure via icv delivery can amplify off-tumor toxicity. In contrast, in an immunocompetent syngeneic DMG model, both iv and icv delivery of a murinized BCAN-gated B7-H3 CAR (mB-SYNC-B7-H3) achieved durable tumor clearance and resistance to rechallenge without any detectable neurotoxicity. Mechanistically, synNotch-primed CAR T cells exhibited reduced exhaustion, enhanced activation, and enrichment of naïve and stem cell memory-like subsets. These findings demonstrate that brain-sensing synNotch CAR T circuits represent a generalizable and translatable strategy for targeting multiple CNS malignancies, including DMG.
items.title_en: Brain-sensing synNotch-CAR T cells enable precise targeting and clearance of diffuse midline glioma in multiple preclinical models.
items.title_cn: 脑感应 synNotch-CAR T 细胞能够在多种临床前模型中精确靶向和清除弥漫性中线神经胶质瘤。
items.abstract_cn: 弥漫性中线神经胶质瘤（DMG）是一种致命的儿童脑肿瘤，治疗选择有限且预后不良。嵌合抗原受体 (CAR) T 细胞疗法的成功需要改善 T 细胞肿瘤浸润和持久性，并降低靶向/脱肿瘤毒性的风险。在这里，我们改编并改进了先前在胶质母细胞瘤中验证的脑限制性 CAR T 细胞平台，以解决 DMG 的解剖学和生物学挑战。我们设计了一个 T 细胞回路，其中脑特异性合成 Notch (synNotch) 受体识别短短聚糖 (BCAN) 诱导针对 EphA2 或 IL-13Rα2 (“B-SYNC”) 的 CAR 表达，从而将 CAR 表达限制在中枢神经系统 (CNS)。在免疫缺陷 DMG 模型中，单次静脉输注 (iv) 或脑室内 (icv) B-SYNC 回路 T 细胞可导致肿瘤浸润、持续存在、抗肿瘤活性和延长生存期。另一种 BCAN 引发的靶向 B7-H3 或 IL-13Rα2（“B-SYNC-B/I”）的 CAR 在静脉注射时同样提高了治疗效果。然而，由于非肿瘤 CNS 区域中 B7-H3 表达水平较低，icv 给药引发了致命的神经毒性，这表明通过 icv 递送快速 CNS 暴露可以放大肿瘤外毒性。相比之下，在免疫活性同基因 DMG 模型中，静脉注射和静脉注射鼠源化 BCAN 门控 B7-H3 CAR (mB-SYNC-B7-H3) 均实现了持久的肿瘤清除和对再攻击的抵抗力，且没有任何可检测到的神经毒性。从机制上讲，synNotch 引发的 CAR T 细胞表现出减少的耗竭、增强的激活以及幼稚细胞和干细胞记忆样亚群的富集。这些发现表明，脑感知 synNotch CAR T 电路代表了一种针对多种 CNS 恶性肿瘤（包括 DMG）的通用且可转化的策略。

items.title: Engineered extracellular vesicles as next-generation platforms for mRNA therapeutics delivery.
items.authors: Yixi Xiao; Xin Tong; Zixi Wang; Yujie Zhang; Shuiyuan Liu; Muzi Tian; Yilin Chen; Lu Gan
items.abstract: mRNA has emerged as a star molecule in pharmaceutical development, demonstrating immense potential for the diagnosis and treatment of cancer, neurological disorders, genetic diseases, and infectious diseases. It has played a particularly pivotal role in COVID-19 prevention. However, the clinical translation of mRNA therapeutics is significantly hampered by its inherent instability, low cellular permeability, and poor targeting specificity. Consequently, the development of efficient mRNA delivery systems represents a paramount challenge for its biomedical application. Conventional delivery platforms, as exemplified by lipid nanoparticles (LNPs), offer advantages including mature manufacturing processes and broad clinical adoption. Nevertheless, they still face limitations such as suboptimal delivery efficiency and biosafety concerns requiring further improvement. Extracellular vesicles (EVs), including exosomes, microvesicles, and apoptotic bodies, have emerged as highly promising mRNA delivery vectors. This is attributed to their low immunogenicity, favorable biosafety profile, intrinsic homing effect-based targeting capability, and amenability to engineering modifications. This review comprehensively summarizes recent advances in EV-mediated mRNA delivery, detailing strategies for mRNA loading into EVs, approaches for achieving targeted mRNA delivery using EVs, and the therapeutic applications of EV-encapsulated mRNA. The synthesis of this knowledge aims to provide insights to advance the clinical implementation of mRNA-based therapeutics.

items.abstract_cn: mRNA 已成为药物开发中的明星分子，在癌症、神经系统疾病、遗传性疾病和传染病的诊断和治疗方面展现出巨大的潜力。它在预防 COVID-19 方面发挥了特别关键的作用。然而，mRNA疗法的临床转化因其固有的不稳定性、低细胞渗透性和较差的靶向特异性而受到严重阻碍。因此，开发有效的 mRNA 递送系统对其生物医学应用来说是一个重大挑战。以脂质纳米粒子 (LNP) 为代表的传统递送平台具有成熟的制造工艺和广泛的临床采用等优势。然而，它们仍然面临诸如递送效率欠佳和需要进一步改进的生物安全问题等限制。细胞外囊泡（EV），包括外泌体、微泡和凋亡小体，已成为非常有前途的 mRNA 递送载体。这归因于它们的低免疫原性、良好的生物安全性、基于内在归巢效应的靶向能力以及易于工程修改。这篇综述全面总结了 EV 介导的 mRNA 递送的最新进展，详细介绍了 mRNA 加载到 EV 中的策略、使用 EV 实现靶向 mRNA 递送的方法以及 EV 封装的 mRNA 的治疗应用。这些知识的综合旨在为推进基于 mRNA 的疗法的临床实施提供见解。

items.title: A TGF-β1-Binding and Stem Cell-Homing Peptide Hydrogel Loaded with BMSC-Exosomes Enhances the Endogenous Repair of Surgically Induced Osteochondral Defects.
items.authors: Weihua Hu; Jun Chen; Feng Yu; Guoqing Yu; Kun Li; Zhilong Chen; Ye Wang; Zi Li
items.abstract: To address the poor self-repair capacity of experimental osteochondral defects and the inefficacy of conventional hydrogels, this study developed a biodegradable peptide hydrogel, Exos@TRM. This study used an acute surgically created osteochondral defect model in rats, which does not fully reproduce experimental cartilage defects or chronic human cartilage degeneration. Based on the RADA16 framework, this hydrogel incorporates a TGF-β1-binding peptide and a stem cell-recruiting motif, and is loaded with exosomes derived from bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs). In vitro experiments demonstrated that Exos@TRM effectively binds TGF-β1, promotes BMSC migration, and enables sustained exosome release for up to one week, thereby facilitating BMSC proliferation and chondrogenic differentiation. In a rat cartilage defect model, Exos@TRM reduced pro-inflammatory M1 macrophages, recruited endogenous TGF-β1 and BMSCs to the injury site, promoted chondrogenic differentiation at week 3, and achieved tissue regeneration resembling natural cartilage with functional mechanical properties by week 8. Mechanistic studies confirmed that the regenerative effects are TGF-β1-dependent, and comprehensive biosafety evaluation revealed no systemic toxicity. This study demonstrates that Exos@TRM achieves significant cartilage repair without exogenous cells or high-dose growth factors through synergistic immunomodulation, localized TGF-β1 recruitment, and stem cell homing, offering a clinically promising strategy for experimental cartilage defects.

items.title_cn: 装载有 BMSC-外泌体的 TGF-β1 结合和干细胞归巢肽水凝胶可增强手术引起的骨软骨缺损的内源性修复。
items.abstract_cn: 为了解决实验性骨软骨缺损自我修复能力差和传统水凝胶无效的问题，本研究开发了一种可生物降解的肽水凝胶Exos@TRM。这项研究使用了通过急性手术创建的大鼠骨软骨缺损模型，该模型不能完全重现实验性软骨缺损或慢性人类软骨退变。该水凝胶基于 RADA16 框架，包含 TGF-β1 结合肽和干细胞招募基序，并装载有源自骨髓间充质干细胞 (BMSC) 的外泌体。体外实验表明，Exos@TRM有效结合TGF-β1，促进BMSC迁移，并能够持续释放外泌体长达一周，从而促进BMSC增殖和软骨分化。在大鼠软骨缺损模型中，Exos@TRM减少促炎性M1巨噬细胞，将内源性TGF-β1和BMSC募集到损伤部位，在第3周促进软骨分化，并在第8周实现类似于天然软骨的组织再生，具有功能性机械特性。机制研究证实，再生作用是TGF-β1依赖性的，综合生物安全性评估显示没有全身毒性。这项研究表明，Exos@TRM 通过协同免疫调节、局部 TGF-β1 募集和干细胞归巢，无需外源细胞或高剂量生长因子即可实现显着的软骨修复，为实验性软骨缺陷提供了一种临床上有前景的策略。

items.title: Translational control of microglial metabolism, inflammatory responses, and survival by the eIF4E-binding proteins.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Sara Bermudez; Jung-Hyun Choi; Niaz Mahmood; Jacob W Vogel; Hashem Almousa; Ziying Huang; Sung-Hoon Kim; Vivian Yuchan Zhu
items.abstract: In Alzheimer's disease (AD), activation of the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) pathway promotes microglial neuroprotective functions by engaging multiple cell receptors. However, the relevant downstream effectors are not fully understood. mTOR complex 1 (mTORC1) promotes mRNA translation by phosphorylating and inactivating eukaryotic translation initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 and 2 (4E-BP1/2), which are expressed in microglia. 4E-BP1 levels in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) are elevated in AD and correlate with markers of microglial reactivity and disease progression. Using linear regression analysis, we found that elevated CSF 4E-BP1 levels strengthen the association between soluble TREM2 levels and neurodegeneration in amyloid-positive individuals. To investigate the underlying mechanism, we performed in vitro experiments demonstrating that amyloid-β inactivated 4E-BP1 in murine microglia. The mTOR-mediated inactivation is highly dependent on Spleen Tyrosine Kinase (SYK) signaling and repeated exposure to amyloid-β impaired this process, whereas prolonged exposure increased 4E-BP1 levels in microglia. Deletion of 4E-BP1/2 resulted in increased mitochondrial mass and oxidative phosphorylation, reduced pro-inflammatory signaling, and protected microglia from amyloid-induced apoptosis. Thus, impaired 4E-BP1 inactivation-due to reduced mTOR signaling or excess 4E-BP1-disrupts immune resolution, leading to metabolic exhaustion and microglial cell death. We identify the SYK-mTORC1-4E-BP1 signaling axis as a key regulator of microglial mitochondrial biogenesis and immune resolution in AD.

items.abstract_cn: 在阿尔茨海默病 (AD) 中，雷帕霉素机械靶点 (mTOR) 通路的激活通过与多个细胞受体结合来促进小胶质细胞的神经保护功能。然而，相关的下游效应器尚未完全了解。 mTOR 复合物 1 (mTORC1) 通过磷酸化和灭活小胶质细胞中表达的真核翻译起始因子 4E 结合蛋白 1 和 2 (4E-BP1/2) 来促进 mRNA 翻译。 AD 患者脑脊液 (CSF) 中的 4E-BP1 水平升高，并且与小胶质细胞反应性和疾病进展的标志物相关。通过线性回归分析，我们发现脑脊液 4E-BP1 水平升高增强了淀粉样蛋白阳性个体中可溶性 TREM2 水平与神经退行性变之间的关联。为了研究其潜在机制，我们进行了体外实验，证明淀粉样蛋白-β 使小鼠小胶质细胞中的 4E-BP1 失活。 mTOR 介导的失活高度依赖于脾酪氨酸激酶 (SYK) 信号传导，反复暴露于淀粉样蛋白-β 会损害这一过程，而长期暴露会增加小胶质细胞中的 4E-BP1 水平。 4E-BP1/2 的缺失导致线粒体质量和氧化磷酸化增加，促炎信号传导减少，并保护小胶质细胞免受淀粉样蛋白诱导的细胞凋亡。因此，由于 mTOR 信号传导减少或 4E-BP1 过量，4E-BP1 失活受损会破坏免疫分辨率，导致代谢衰竭和小胶质细胞死亡。我们确定 SYK-mTORC1-4E-BP1 信号轴是 AD 中小胶质细胞线粒体生物发生和免疫解决的关键调节因子。

items.title: Macrophage lipid signaling drives glioblastoma invasion and represents a therapeutic vulnerability.
items.authors: Carla Pallarés-Moratalla; Mélanie Guyot; Krish Skandha Gopalan; Bernhard Robl; Jakub Idkowiak; Jonas Dehairs; Nina Ravoet; Tim F E Hendriks
items.abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is characterized by diffuse infiltration into the surrounding brain, limiting complete surgical resection, the strongest determinant of patient survival. The mechanisms driving this invasive growth remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify a lipid-mediated paracrine signaling axis through which tumor-associated microglia/macrophages promote glioma invasion. Integrating single-cell transcriptomics, spatial lipidomics, and functional perturbation across mouse models and human GBM samples, we show that invading tumor cells engage and reprogram myeloid cells via colony-stimulating factor-1 receptor (CSF1R)-PI3K signaling. This induces lipid metabolic reprogramming and secretion of bioactive lipids, including lysophosphatidylcholines (LPCs) and lysophosphatidic acids (LPAs), which promote GBM invasion through distinct downstream pathways. Disruption of this myeloid-GBM axis reduces lipid secretion and suppresses invasion. Targeting downstream LPA-LPA receptor (LPAR) or YAP/TAZ signaling further constrains invasion in a context-dependent manner. Together, these findings define a lipid-driven circuit linking the tumor microenvironment to glioma invasion and identify strategies to reduce infiltration and improve surgical resection.

items.abstract_cn: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）的特点是弥漫性浸润到周围大脑，限制了完整的手术切除，这是患者生存的最强决定因素。驱动这种侵入性生长的机制仍不完全清楚。在这里，我们确定了脂质介导的旁分泌信号轴，肿瘤相关的小胶质细胞/巨噬细胞通过该信号轴促进神经胶质瘤侵袭。整合小鼠模型和人类 GBM 样本中的单细胞转录组学、空间脂质组学和功能扰动，我们发现入侵的肿瘤细胞通过集落刺激因子 1 受体 (CSF1R)-PI3K 信号传导参与并重新编程骨髓细胞。这会诱导脂质代谢重编程和生物活性脂质的分泌，包括溶血磷脂酰胆碱 (LPC) 和溶血磷脂酸 (LPA)，它们通过不同的下游途径促进 GBM 侵袭。骨髓-GBM 轴的破坏会减少脂质分泌并抑制侵袭。靶向下游 LPA-LPA 受体 (LPAR) 或 YAP/TAZ 信号传导以上下文依赖性方式进一步限制入侵。总之，这些发现定义了将肿瘤微环境与神经胶质瘤侵袭联系起来的脂质驱动回路，并确定了减少浸润和改善手术切除的策略。

items.title: Intranasal insulin improves long-term cognitive deficits and protects hippocampal damage following neonatal hypoxia-ischemia in juvenile rats.
items.authors: Nilesh Dankhara; Jonathan W Lee; Norma B Ojeda; Michelle A Tucci; Silu Lu; Elizabeth L White; Lindsey E Winborne; Sharon Xu
items.abstract: Hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy remains a significant cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality in neonates. Our study tested whether intranasal insulin provides long-term neuroprotection against neonatal hypoxia-ischemia (HI)-induced hippocampal damage and cognitive disturbances in juvenile rats. Postnatal day 10 (P10) Sprague-Dawley rats underwent right common carotid artery ligation or sham surgery followed by 90 min of hypoxia (8% oxygen) or room air, respectively. Immediately after, insulin (25 μg) or vehicle was administered in each naris, followed by repeated doses 24 and 48 h post-insult. HI caused acute cerebral ATP depletion, an acute inflammatory response characterized by increased IL-1β, and corticosterone elevation. Intranasal insulin significantly attenuated ATP loss, reduced interleukin-1β and corticosterone levels, and improved somatic growth. Behaviorally, intranasal insulin protected against neonatal HI-induced sensorimotor deficits, working memory impairments, and learning deficits in both sexes of juvenile rats (P21-P25). Male pups exhibited selective long-term memory deficits following HI, which were fully rescued by intranasal insulin. Histologically, neonatal HI induced hippocampal neuronal loss and increased Fluoro-Jade C + degenerating cells, together with loss of mature NeuN + neurons in hippocampal CA3, and suppression of dentate gyrus neurogenesis, with greater loss of immature DCX + neurons in P25 male rats. HI insult also resulted in brain inflammation, as indicated by microglia activation (Iba1 + ) and serum interleukin-1β elevation. Intranasal insulin significantly reduced HI-induced brain inflammation and protected against hippocampal neuronal injury in both sexes. These findings demonstrate long-lasting neuroprotective effects of intranasal insulin following neonatal HI and support further investigation of this non-invasive approach for hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy in neonates.
items.title_en: Intranasal insulin improves long-term cognitive deficits and protects hippocampal damage following neonatal hypoxia-ischemia in juvenile rats.
items.title_cn: 鼻内胰岛素可改善幼年大鼠的长期认知缺陷并保护新生缺氧缺血后的海马损伤。
items.abstract_cn: 缺氧缺血性脑病仍然是新生儿发病和死亡的重要原因。我们的研究测试了鼻内胰岛素是否可以针对新生期缺氧缺血（HI）引起的幼年大鼠海马损伤和认知障碍提供长期神经保护。出生后第 10 天 (P10) Sprague-Dawley 大鼠接受右颈总动脉结扎或假手术，然后分别进行 90 分钟的缺氧（8% 氧气）或室内空气。紧接着，在每个鼻孔中注射胰岛素（25μg）或载体，然后在攻击后24和48小时重复给药。 HI 引起急性脑 ATP 耗竭，这是一种以 IL-1β 增加和皮质酮升高为特征的急性炎症反应。鼻内胰岛素显着减少 ATP 损失，降低白细胞介素 1β 和皮质酮水平，并改善体细胞生长。在行为上，鼻内胰岛素可以防止新生 HI 引起的幼年大鼠的感觉运动缺陷、工作记忆障碍和学习缺陷（P21-P25）。雄性幼崽在HI后表现出选择性长期记忆缺陷，但通过鼻内胰岛素完全恢复。在组织学上，新生儿HI诱导海马神经元损失和Fluoro-Jade C + 变性细胞增加，同时海马CA3中成熟NeuN + 神经元损失，并抑制齿状回神经发生，P25雄性大鼠中未成熟DCX + 神经元损失更大。小胶质细胞激活 (Iba1 + ) 和血清白细胞介素 1β 升高表明，HI 损伤还会导致脑部炎症。鼻内胰岛素可显着减少 HI 引起的脑部炎症，并防止男女海马神经元损伤。这些发现证明了新生儿HI后鼻内胰岛素具有持久的神经保护作用，并支持进一步研究这种治疗新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病的非侵入性方法。

items.title: TREM2: friend or foe in glioma?
items.authors: Mekenzie M Peshoff; Dolores Hambardzumyan; Long-Jun Wu
items.abstract: Triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells 2 (TREM2) is a neuroimmune signaling hub involved in key cellular processes including microglial phagocytosis, chemotaxis, and inflammation. Dysregulation of TREM2 has been implicated in a variety of diseases, most notably in the innate immune response to neurodegenerative disorders and cancer. The TREM2 pathway plays a significant role in governing microglia phenotypic transitions in Alzheimer's disease, as well as in regulating tumor-associated macrophages' ability to modulate cytotoxic activity. However, TREM2's role can be dependent on experimental parameters and disease contexts. Due to its intricate involvement in related disorders and the myeloid-dominated microenvironment in brain tumors, TREM2 has emerged as a vital player to better understand neuroimmune contributions to central nervous system malignancies. This review critically evaluates TREM2's controversial function in gliomas, analyzes experimental and biological variables that may underlie divergent findings, and outlines important considerations for future investigations.

items.title: Intraventricular clindamycin enhances interstitial brain fluid drainage and the blood-brain barrier after a traumatic brain injury.
items.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
items.authors: Landon S Ashby; Megan G Crowe; Daveraj Chakravarty; Sanjeev Medam; Gabriel Frampton; Ayesha B Das; David A Hormuth; Thomas E Yankeelov
items.abstract: Despite advances in the acute clinical management of severe traumatic brain injuries (TBIs), treating injury-derived secondary pathogenesis remains challenging. We demonstrate intracerebroventricular (I.C.V.) administration of clindamycin alleviates TBI secondary pathogenesis in both focal and diffuse murine models of brain injury. I.C.V. administration of clindamycin increased the motility of ependymal cilia, which line the ventricles and spinal canal, by 30 to 60%, which correlated with interstitial brain fluid drainage through the cortex (r > 0.9 Pearson, n = 4 compounds tested). I.C.V. clindamycin treatment post-TBI also restored the blood-brain barrier (BBB), decreased lesion size, and lowered serum levels of glial fibrillary acidic protein by 2.8-fold. Consistent with these data, a novel objective recognition test revealed an improvement in recognition memory in brain-injured mice treated with clindamycin. These collective findings reveal a counterintuitive finding that I.C.V. clindamycin enhances drainage of toxins from the brain while simultaneously restoring the BBB, potentially providing a new solution for alleviating secondary pathogenesis in brain-injured patients.

items.title_cn: 脑室内注射克林霉素可增强脑外伤后间质脑液引流和血脑屏障。
items.abstract_cn: 尽管严重创伤性脑损伤（TBIs）的急性临床治疗取得了进展，但治疗损伤引起的继发性发病机制仍然具有挑战性。我们证明，在局灶性和弥漫性脑损伤小鼠模型中，脑室内 (I.C.V.) 给予克林霉素可减轻 TBI 继发性发病机制。 I.C.V.给予克林霉素可使脑室和椎管内的室管膜纤毛的运动性增加 30% 至 60%，这与通过皮质的间质脑液引流相关（r > 0.9 Pearson，n = 4 种测试化合物）。 I.C.V. TBI 后的克林霉素治疗还可以恢复血脑屏障 (BBB)、缩小病变大小并将神经胶质纤维酸性蛋白的血清水平降低 2.8 倍。与这些数据一致，一项新颖的客观识别测试显示，接受克林霉素治疗的脑损伤小鼠的识别记忆有所改善。这些集体发现揭示了一个违反直觉的发现：I.C.V.克林霉素可增强大脑中毒素的排出，同时恢复血脑屏障，这可能为减轻脑损伤患者的继发性发病机制提供新的解决方案。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Brain-sensing synNotch-CAR T cells enable precise targeting and clearance of diffuse midline glioma in multiple preclinical models.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Senthilnath Lakshmanachetty; Milos S Simic; Payal B Watchmaker; Robert Zhu; Takahide Nejo; Maggie Colton Cove; Jeffrey Haegelin; Haoyu Long
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Diffuse midline glioma (DMG) is a lethal pediatric brain tumor with limited therapeutic options and a poor prognosis. The success of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy requires both improving T cell tumor infiltration and persistence and reducing the risk of on-target/off-tumor toxicity. Here, we adapted and advanced a brain-restricted CAR T cell platform previously validated in glioblastoma to address the anatomical and biological challenges of DMG. We engineered a T cell circuit in which a brain-specific synthetic Notch (synNotch) receptor recognizing brevican (BCAN) induced CAR expression against EphA2 or IL-13Rα2 ("B-SYNC"), thereby restricting CAR expression to the central nervous system (CNS). In immunodeficient DMG models, a single infusion of intravenous (iv) or intracerebroventricular (icv) B-SYNC circuit T cells led to tumor infiltration, sustained persistence, antitumor activity, and extended survival. An alternative BCAN-primed CAR targeting B7-H3 or IL-13Rα2 ("B-SYNC-B/I") similarly improved therapeutic efficacy when delivered intravenously. However, icv administration triggered fatal neurotoxicity because of low-level B7-H3 expression in nontumor CNS regions, indicating that rapid CNS exposure via icv delivery can amplify off-tumor toxicity. In contrast, in an immunocompetent syngeneic DMG model, both iv and icv delivery of a murinized BCAN-gated B7-H3 CAR (mB-SYNC-B7-H3) achieved durable tumor clearance and resistance to rechallenge without any detectable neurotoxicity. Mechanistically, synNotch-primed CAR T cells exhibited reduced exhaustion, enhanced activation, and enrichment of naïve and stem cell memory-like subsets. top_journal_neuroscience.title: TREM2: friend or foe in glioma?
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Mekenzie M Peshoff; Dolores Hambardzumyan; Long-Jun Wu
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Triggering receptor expressed on myeloid cells 2 (TREM2) is a neuroimmune signaling hub involved in key cellular processes including microglial phagocytosis, chemotaxis, and inflammation. Dysregulation of TREM2 has been implicated in a variety of diseases, most notably in the innate immune response to neurodegenerative disorders and cancer. The TREM2 pathway plays a significant role in governing microglia phenotypic transitions in Alzheimer's disease, as well as in regulating tumor-associated macrophages' ability to modulate cytotoxic activity. However, TREM2's role can be dependent on experimental parameters and disease contexts. Due to its intricate involvement in related disorders and the myeloid-dominated microenvironment in brain tumors, TREM2 has emerged as a vital player to better understand neuroimmune contributions to central nervous system malignancies. This review critically evaluates TREM2's controversial function in gliomas, analyzes experimental and biological variables that may underlie divergent findings, and outlines important considerations for future investigations.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Microglial NUS1 deficiency drives dopaminergic neurodegeneration through intercellular iron dysregulation in Parkinson's disease models.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Lele Liu; Yan Hong; Xiying Wang; Xiurong Huang; Yanni Ma; Rui Wang; Qian Sun; Hongyang Sun
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: The selective loss of dopaminergic neurons in the substantia nigra pars compacta is a defining feature of Parkinson's disease (PD), yet its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. NUS1, which encodes neurite outgrowth inhibitor-B receptor (NgBR), was recently identified as a PD risk gene. Here we show that NgBR is highly expressed in microglia, where its deficiency drives progressive PD-like motor deficits and dopaminergic neurodegeneration via the LCN2-SLC22A17 iron-transport axis in mice. NgBR deficiency in mouse and human microglia triggers endoplasmic reticulum stress and PERK-ATF4-NUPR1 signaling, which preferentially induces LCN2-mediated iron efflux over cytokine release. Subsequently, microglia-derived iron-loaded Holo-LCN2, but not iron-free Apo-LCN2, is internalized by SLC22A17, a receptor highly expressed in dopaminergic neurons, leading to iron overload and ferroptosis. Pharmacological inhibition of LCN2-SLC22A17 axis or ferroptosis alleviated dopaminergic neuron loss and PD-like symptoms caused by microglial NgBR deficiency in vitro and in vivo. Our findings identify disrupted intercellular iron homeostasis as a pathological driver of PD and highlight the LCN2-SLC22A17 axis as a potential therapeutic target.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Dengue virus controlled human challenge reveals that preexisting immunity shapes viral replication and broadly protective responses.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Camila D Odio; Rosemary A Aogo; Saba Firdous; Charlie Voirin; Silvia Blanco-Rivera; Kelsey E Lowman; Nhyira Asante; Ysabelle Broderson
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Dengue is the canonical viral disease for which immune history is a determinant of protective versus pathogenic responses and immunogenicity. Yet, because of limitations in animal models and clinical presentation after peak viremia, how preinfection and early immune responses affect dengue outcome is not confirmed. We conducted a phase 1 clinical trial with 45 healthy adults to test whether secondary infection challenge with a heterotypic, full-length, attenuated virus increases viremia and immunogenicity compared with primary and tertiary infection. Viremia was associated with more, but still mild, clinical signs and symptoms, and secondary infection resulted in greater viremia, neutralizing antibodies, and protective T cell responses. However, those whose baseline antibodies most efficiently increased dengue virus replication in an in vitro assay experienced delayed inflammatory and adaptive immune activation, the highest viremia, strong acute immune responses, and waning of potent CD8+ T cells and antibodies. top_journal_neuroscience.title: KCNH1 variants associated with neurodevelopmental disorders exhibit prominent gain of function.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Christopher H Thompson; Christine Q Simmons; Isabella K He; Nirvani P Jairam; Reshma R Desai; Esther Cha; Alexandra E Hong; Jean-Marc DeKeyser
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Pathogenic variants in KCNH1, encoding the human ether-á-go-go voltage-gated potassium channel (EAG1, KV10.1), are associated with the neurodevelopmental disorders Temple-Baraitser syndrome (TBS), Zimmermann-Laband syndrome (ZLS), epileptic encephalopathy, and other undefined neurodevelopmental disorders. Investigating the functional consequences of KCNH1 variants can provide information about molecular and cellular pathophysiological mechanisms and help guide therapeutic directions. In this study, we determined the functional properties of 26 disease-associated KCNH1 variants including three recurrent and six that were previously unpublished. Findings were compared to the wildtype (WT) channel along with six rare population variants. Our approach used automated patch clamp recording of heterologously expressed KCNH1 variants in both the homozygous state (variant alone) and the clinically-relevant heterozygous state (variant co-expressed with WT channels). We also examined the impact of alternative splice isoforms on functional consequences of specific variants. We demonstrated that the majority of disease-associated KCNH1 variants exhibit features consistent with gain-of-function including hyperpolarized voltage-dependence of activation, accelerated activation kinetics, or both that promote hyperpolarization of the resting membrane potential. By contrast, one unique variant discovered previously in an autism cohort had a depolarized voltage-dependence of activation and was associated with a depolarized resting potential in cells. Pharmacological testing of KCNH1 variants demonstrated differences in potency for channel block by imipramine and an investigational non-selective potassium channel blocker (LY97241) for specific variants. Collectively, our findings support gain-of-function as the most common, albeit not exclusive, molecular mechanism underlying KCNH1-related disorders and suggest opportunities for potential therapeutic drug repurposing strategies for these conditions.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Short-term outcomes, longer-term disability and relapse risk in LGI1-antibody encephalitis.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Sudarshini Ramanathan; John Soltys; Sophia Michael; Samuel V Mackrill; Jonathan Cleaver; Robyn Williams; Mateusz Makuch; Patrick Waters
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: Leucine-rich glioma-inactivated-1 antibody encephalitis (LGI1-Ab-E) is a common and immunotherapy-responsive form of encephalitis. However, it is not known which immunotherapy regimens improve short-term outcomes, longer-term disability and relapse risk. Further, it is not known if the widely-utilised modified Rankin Scale (mRS) accurately captures quality of life (QoL) in LGI1-Ab-E, complicating disability measurements and interpretation of immunotherapy responses. A multicentre, international, real-world comparative analysis of patients with LGI1-Ab-E. Retrospective data from patient records evaluated short-term seizure and cognitive outcomes, 1-6 year disability, and future relapse risk associations, by integrating demographics, clinical features investigations and exposures to immunotherapies and antiseizure medications (ASMs). Patient- and neurologist-rated QoL assessments were used to establish an evidence-based mRS threshold for defining clinically significant disability. Cox proportional hazard models, Anderson-Gill, and generalised linear mixed-effects models were employed. 181 patients were included, with median age at onset 63 years (range 23 - 92); 122/181 (67%) were male. Short-term outcomes, evaluated at both five and ten weeks post-treatment initiation, identified exposure to immunotherapies associated with seizure resolution (OR = 13.97, 95%CI = 6.10-32.01; p < 0.0001 and OR = 8.53, 95%CI = 4.14-17.55; p < 0.0001, respectively), notably with corticosteroids, plasma exchange and rituximab, but not ASMs, intravenous immunoglobulins or steroid sparing agents. Conversely, seizure recurrence was observed after discontinuation of oral prednisolone, but not other immunotherapies or ASMs (OR = 39.53, 95%CI = 12.70-122.20, p < 0.0001). To evaluate longer-term disability, first, mRS scores were calibrated using QoL assessments: this identified a significant increase in patient-rated disability at mRS score of 2. Hence, using mRS 0-1 as a favourable outcome, we identified worse mRS at nadir associated with greater one-year disability (OR = 2.56, 95%CI = 1.56-4.20, p = 0.0003), and each month of delayed immunotherapy associated with a 16% increased risk of disability (HR = 1.16, 95%CI = 1.06-1.35, p = 0.004). Additionally, absence of immunotherapy associated both with greater one-year disability (OR = 5.67; 95% CI 1.19-26.54, p = 0.03) and a relapsing course (OR = 7.64, 95%CI = 2.51-21.77, p = 0.0002). Both a relapsing course, observed in 38% of patients, and the number of relapses associated with step-wise worsening of disability and QoL-outcomes. Rituximab exposure was the only identified clinical factor associated with reduced future relapse risk, by 93% (HR = 0.07, 95%CI = 0.01-0.48, p = 0.002). Persistent serum LGI1-IgMs, but not LGI1-IgGs, at one-year, associated with future relapses (HR = 11.69, 95%CI = 1.58-145.80, p = 0.02). Distinctive clinical factors and select immunotherapies, particularly intravenous methylprednisolone and plasma exchange, but not ASMs, associated with favourable short-term outcomes, patient-centric longer-term disability and relapses in LGI1-Ab-E. Our findings provide evidence-based disability thresholds, highlight novel prognostic biomarkers, and pragmatically guide LGI1-Ab-E care, pending randomized clinical trials.

top_journal_neuroscience.title: Neoadjuvant durvalumab plus chemotherapy in resectable or borderline resectable non-small-cell lung cancer: the phase 2 MDT-BRIDGE trial.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Martin Reck; Ernest Nadal; Carl M Gay; Nicolas Girard; Andrea Riccardo Filippi; Linda W Martin; Cordula Petersen; David A Cairns
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: The phase 2 MDT-BRIDGE study is investigating perioperative durvalumab plus neoadjuvant chemotherapy (AEGEAN regimen) in resectable and borderline resectable non-small-cell lung cancer and chemoradiotherapy (CRT) followed by consolidation durvalumab (PACIFIC regimen) in patients who become unresectable after neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy guided by multidisciplinary team assessments during the neoadjuvant period. The primary endpoint was the overall resection rate (descriptive with no formal hypothesis testing). Secondary endpoints included event-free survival, progression-free survival, pathological complete response rate (resectable patients cohort), circulating tumor DNA clearance between baseline and presurgery/pre-CRT and safety. Overall, 142 patients received neoadjuvant treatment; 64.8% and 35.2% were deemed resectable and borderline resectable at baseline, respectively. The overall resection rate (95% confidence interval) was 74.6% (66.7‒81.6) in a population that included more than one-third of patients with borderline resectable disease. R0 resection rate was 96.2% (90.6‒99.0) in those who underwent surgery. Overall, 131 (92.3%) patients had surgery (n = 106) or CRT (n = 25) after neoadjuvant treatment, and 117 (82.4%) patients received adjuvant (n = 94) or consolidation (n = 23) durvalumab. During adjuvant or consolidation durvalumab, maximum grade 3/4 adverse events occurred in 7.4% of resected patients and 17.4% of CRT-treated patients, with 8.5% and 13.0% discontinuing treatment due to adverse events. This multidisciplinary team-guided approach was feasible and enabled delivery of curative-intent treatment (surgery or CRT), followed by durvalumab in most patients, and demonstrated encouraging preliminary efficacy with a manageable adjuvant or consolidation safety profile that was consistent with prior studies. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT05925530 .

top_journal_neuroscience.title_cn: 新辅助 durvalumab 联合化疗治疗可切除或临界可切除非小细胞肺癌：2 期 MDT-BRIDGE 试验。
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 2 期 MDT-BRIDGE 研究正在研究可切除和临界可切除非小细胞肺癌的围手术期 durvalumab 联合新辅助化疗（AEGEAN 方案），以及在新辅助期间多学科团队评估指导下的新辅助化学免疫治疗后无法切除的患者中进行放化疗（CRT），然后进行巩固 durvalumab（PACIFIC 方案）。主要终点是总体切除率（描述性的，没有正式的假设检验）。次要终点包括无事件生存期、无进展生存期、病理完全缓解率（可切除患者队列）、基线和手术前/CRT 前的循环肿瘤 DNA 清除率以及安全性。总体而言，142 名患者接受了新辅助治疗；基线时分别有 64.8% 和 35.2% 被认为可切除和临界可切除。在超过三分之一患有临界可切除疾病的患者群体中，总体切除率（95% 置信区间）为 74.6% (66.7-81.6)。接受手术的患者中，R0 切除率为 96.2%（90.6-99.0）。总体而言，131 名 (92.3%) 患者在新辅助治疗后接受了手术 (n = 106) 或 CRT (n = 25)，117 名 (82.4%) 患者接受了辅助 (n = 94) 或巩固 (n = 23) 度瓦鲁单抗。在辅助或巩固 durvalumab 期间，7.4% 的切除患者和 17.4% 的 CRT 治疗患者发生最大 3/4 级不良事件，其中 8.5% 和 13.0% 由于不良事件而停止治疗。这种多学科团队指导的方法是可行的，能够在大多数患者中提供治愈性治疗（手术或 CRT），然后进行杜瓦鲁单抗（durvalumab），并且通过与之前的研究一致的可管理的辅助或巩固安全性证明了令人鼓舞的初步疗效。 ClinicalTrials.gov 标识符：NCT05925530。

top_journal_neuroscience.title: In vivo genome-editing therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy: Preclinical studies and first-in-human trial.
top_journal_neuroscience.authors: Guoling Li; Feng Han; Cuijin Wang; Ming Jin; Jiajia Lin; Hainan Zhang; Xiudong Yan; Xing Wang
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract: We report the preclinical and early clinical evaluation of in vivo genome editing for Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), delivered via a single AAV9 vector. In humanized DMD mice, systemic administration achieved targeted genome editing, partial dystrophin restoration, and improved muscle function. In non-human primates, efficient on-target editing was achieved with no dose-limiting toxicity identified under the conditions tested. In an open-label, dose-escalation, first-in-human clinical trial (NCT06594094), post-treatment muscle biopsies provided early molecular evidence of hfCas12Max-mediated genome editing and detectable dystrophin expression in participants with DMD. However, at the higher dose level (1.0 × 1014 vg/kg), one participant experienced a treatment-related fatal serious adverse event, characterized by marked complement activation and systemic cytokine response shortly after dosing. This work provides initial human proof-of-concept for muscle genome editing while crucially highlighting the critical role of immunologic risks and the narrow therapeutic window of systemic adeno-associated virus (AAV)-CRISPR therapies, underscoring the need to develop safer dosing and immunomodulation strategies.

top_journal_neuroscience.title_cn: 杜氏肌营养不良症的体内基因组编辑疗法：临床前研究和首次人体试验。
top_journal_neuroscience.abstract_cn: 我们报告了通过单个 AAV9 载体进行杜氏肌营养不良症 (DMD) 体内基因组编辑的临床前和早期临床评估。在人源化 DMD 小鼠中，全身给药实现了靶向基因组编辑、部分肌营养不良蛋白恢复和肌肉功能改善。在非人类灵长类动物中，实现了有效的定点编辑，并且在测试条件下没有发现剂量限制毒性。在一项开放标签、剂量递增、首次人体临床试验 (NCT06594094) 中，治疗后肌肉活检提供了 DMD 参与者中 hfCas12Max 介导的基因组编辑和可检测的肌营养不良蛋白表达的早期分子证据。然而，在较高剂量水平（1.0 × 1014 vg/kg）下，一名参与者经历了与治疗相关的致命性严重不良事件，其特征是给药后不久出现明显的补体激活和全身细胞因子反应。这项工作为肌肉基因组编辑提供了初步的人体概念验证，同时重要地强调了免疫风险的关键作用和全身性腺相关病毒（AAV）-CRISPR 疗法的狭窄治疗窗口，强调需要开发更安全的剂量和免疫调节策略。

global_hot_topics.title: Single-arm feasibility trial of manualized outpatient morita therapy for panic disorder with agoraphobia.
global_hot_topics.journal: PCN reports : psychiatry and clinical neurosciences
global_hot_topics.authors: Kiwako Yokoyama; Daisuke Yamaichi; Shigetsugu Nakao; Mitsuhiro Nakamura; Hiroyuki Uchida; Hidehito Niimura
global_hot_topics.abstract: AIM: This single-arm feasibility trial evaluated the feasibility and safety of a manualized outpatient Morita therapy (MT) program for patients with panic disorder (PD) and agoraphobia in routine psychiatric care, and explored preliminary signals of symptom change. METHODS: Ten outpatients with PD and agoraphobia were enrolled in a 12-session manualized MT program. Feasibility outcomes included retention, attendance, and therapist adherence. Exploratory outcomes were the changes in scores of the Panic and Agoraphobia Scale (PAS), the Generalized Anxiety Disorder Scale-7 (GAD-7), the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9), and the Short Form-36 Health Survey (SF-36), assessed from baseline to the 6-month follow-up. Data were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models. RESULTS: Feasibility criteria were met. The completion rate was 90%, with a mean attendance of 11.6/12 sessions. Therapists reported high manual fidelity and usability. Exploratory analyses showed improvements in PAS (Hedges' g = 1.53, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.57-2.45) at 6-month follow-up, GAD-7 (g = 1.24, 95% CI 0.38-2.06), PHQ-9 (g = 1.05, 95% CI 0.25-1.80), and the Mental Component Summary of SF-36 (g = 1.71, 95% CI 0.68-2.70). The Role/Social Component Summary of SF-36 improved at post-treatment (g = 0.82, 95% CI 0.09-1.51) but not at follow-up (g = 0.45, 95% CI -0.19-1.06). No significant changes were observed in the Physical Component Summary of SF-36 (g = -0.14, 95% CI -0.72-0.46). CONCLUSION: Manualized outpatient MT appears feasible and safe for patients with PD and agoraphobia. Preliminary effects on symptoms warrant confirmation in randomized controlled trials.

global_hot_topics.title: FMOD marks a low-malignancy epithelial state in prostate cancer: an ECM-related prognostic signature with single-cell and functional validation.
global_hot_topics.authors: Zhen Li; Xinyang Cai; Yichi Zhang; Ning Pan; Jianjun Luo; Yuanwei Li; Xi Guo
global_hot_topics.abstract: Extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling promotes prostate cancer progression, while the prognostic value and cellular context of ECM-related genes (ERGs) remain unclear. A 4-gene ERG signature for disease-free interval prediction was built using TCGA-PRAD data, and the hub gene Fibromodulin (FMOD) was validated in an external cohort via scRNA-seq, bulk deconvolution and siRNA knockdown. The signature stratified patient prognosis, and FMOD exerted the strongest protective effect. Despite higher bulk expression in tumor tissues, FMOD predicted better clinical outcomes. FMOD was enriched in a low-chromosomal-instability, low-proliferation epithelial subpopulation with enhanced stromal-immune crosstalk, and FMOD knockdown boosted cancer cell proliferation and colony formation. FMOD identifies a low-malignancy epithelial state linked to favorable prostate cancer prognosis, supporting cell state-resolved validation of ECM-related prognostic biomarkers.

global_hot_topics.title: Targeting G2/M checkpoint vulnerability in homologous recombination-proficient tumors: lessons from ovarian cancer models.
global_hot_topics.authors: Qian Xi; Akiko Kunita; Saeko Nagai; Anh Quynh Duong; Masanori Kawakami; Katsutoshi Oda
global_hot_topics.abstract: Cell cycle dysregulation is a hallmark of cancer; however, tumors retaining homologous recombination (HR)-proficiency remain a major challenge. Although PARP inhibitors effectively target HR-deficient cancers, targeted therapies for BRCA1/2-wild-type, HR-proficient tumors are limited. High-grade serous ovarian cancer, approximately half of which is HR-proficient, illustrates that HR proficiency, together with replication stress and checkpoint dependence, may represent both a mechanism of therapeutic resistance and a druggable dependency on checkpoint-coupled DNA repair. This review synthesizes evidence that targeting either PLK1 or WEE1 independently exposes this vulnerability. PLK1 and WEE1 inhibition engage distinct mechanisms: PLK1 inhibition disrupts spindle assembly and HR competence, whereas WEE1 inhibition amplifies replication stress and forces premature mitotic entry. Nevertheless, both ultimately converge to compromise HR-associated repair, promote unresolved DNA damage, and trigger lethal mitotic catastrophe. Finally, we discuss biomarker-unselected trial failures, functional and replication stress-based patient stratification, and rational combinations with DNA-damaging agents and immunotherapy.
global_hot_topics.title_en: Targeting G2/M checkpoint vulnerability in homologous recombination-proficient tumors: lessons from ovarian cancer models.

global_hot_topics.abstract_cn: 细胞周期失调是癌症的一个标志；然而，肿瘤保持同源重组（HR）能力仍然是一个重大挑战。尽管 PARP 抑制剂能有效靶向 HR 缺陷的癌症，但针对 BRCA1/2 野生型、HR 丰富的肿瘤的靶向治疗有限。高级别浆液性卵巢癌，其中大约一半是 HR 熟练的，这表明 HR 熟练程度以及复制应激和检查点依赖性可能代表了治疗耐药机制和对检查点偶联 DNA 修复的药物依赖性。本次审查综合了证据，表明针对 PLK1 或 WEE1 会独立暴露此漏洞。 PLK1 和 WEE1 抑制涉及不同的机制：PLK1 抑制会破坏纺锤体组装和 HR 能力，而 WEE1 抑制会放大复制压力并迫使过早进入有丝分裂。然而，两者最终共同损害 HR 相关修复，促进未解决的 DNA 损伤，并引发致命的有丝分裂灾难。最后，我们讨论了生物标志物未选择的试验失败、基于功能和复制压力的患者分层，以及 DNA 损伤剂和免疫疗法的合理组合。

global_hot_topics.title: Glioblastoma immune landscape remodeling following treatment with CD70-targeted CAR-T cells.
global_hot_topics.authors: Alexandros Kourtesakis; Dennis Alexander Agardy; Clara Tejido Dierssen; Ling Hai; Dirk Carsten Frieder Hoffmann; Normann Mussnig; Ralph Sinn; Manuel Fischer
global_hot_topics.abstract: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T cell therapy has shown limited efficacy in glioblastoma (GB), largely because of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). We have previously demonstrated that the ligand-based mCD70-directed construct mCAR27 specifically eliminates CD70⁺ GB cells in vitro, and induces durable tumor remission with prolonged survival in a syngeneic model of orthotopic GB. Despite the therapeutic promise of CD70 as a GB CAR-T cell target, the impact of CD70-directed CAR-T cells on the brain tumor immune landscape after target interception remains unexplored. Here, we independently confirmed a tumorigenic role for CD70 in murine GB by performing bulk RNA sequencing and in vivo experiments. Next, we applied single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) to decipher the transcriptome of GB-infiltrating immune cells in immunocompetent mice bearing CD70+ GB after intratumoral mCAR27 therapy. CAR-T cell treatment expanded adoptively transferred cells and was associated with increased endogenous Cd8⁺ T-cell infiltration, alongside a reduction in immunosuppressive populations, including Tregs and anti-inflammatory M2-like macrophages, but also subsets of dendritic and natural-killer cells. CD70 expression was detected on multiple GB-infiltrating immune subsets, notably Tregs and M2-like macrophages. Transcriptionally, mCAR27-mediated GB remission led to a coordinated downregulation of type-I interferon-stimulated genes and immunosuppressive mediators such as Arg1, Tgfbi, Cd274, Pdcd1lg2 and Lag3, coupled with upregulation of genes involved in inflammatory resolution, findings consistent with attenuation of GB-derived inflammatory stress and immunosuppression. Collectively, we showcase that CD70-directed CAR-T cell therapy remodels the post-treatment immune landscape towards resolution of inflammation and reduced immunosuppression, supporting sustained immune surveillance.

global_hot_topics.title: Comorbid asthma - occurrence and associations with patient-related outcomes in COPD: a cohort study.
global_hot_topics.journal: Scandinavian journal of primary health care
global_hot_topics.authors: Åsa Athlin; Karin Lisspers; Mikael Hasselgren; Björn Ställberg; Hanna Sandelowsky; Maaike Giezeman; Christer Janson; Marta A Kisiel
global_hot_topics.abstract: PURPOSE: Clinical features of COPD and asthma overlap, complicating differential diagnosis. This study investigated the prevalence of comorbid asthma in COPD patients and its association with patient-related outcomes. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Patients with a doctor's diagnosis of COPD were randomly selected in two cohorts 2005 (n = 1060) and 2014 (n = 1671), from primary and secondary care in Sweden. Data were collected from medical records and patient questionnaires at baseline and at follow-up (2012 and 2022, respectively). Questionnaires included data on exacerbations. Symptoms were assessed using the clinical COPD questionnaire (CCQ). Comorbid asthma was identified through medical records. Ten-year mortality data were obtained from national registers. Logistic and linear regression assessed associations with patient-reported outcomes; Cox regression was applied for mortality analyses. RESULTS: Comorbid asthma was found in 22% of the 2005 cohort and 9% of the 2014 cohort (p < .001). In both cohorts, it was associated with an increased risk of exacerbations: OR (95% CI) 1.58 (1.07-2.32), p = .02, and 2.20 (1.38-3.52), p < .001, respectively. No associations were found between comorbid asthma and worsening of health status (CCQ). Mortality risk did not differ in the 2005 cohort, HR (95% CI) 0.92 (0.71-1.18), but was lower in the 2014 cohort, HR (95% CI) 0.67 (0.49-0.93), p = .02. CONCLUSION: Comorbid asthma in COPD has changed from 22 to 9%, potentially due to improved diagnostics. Comorbid asthma remains clinically relevant due to its association with an increased exacerbation risk.

global_hot_topics.title: Beyond stroke: atrial fibrillation and the broader burden of thromboembolic events in the population-based EpiHealth study.
global_hot_topics.authors: Pernilla Höiby; Moncef Zarrouk; Lars Lind; Rani Basna; Marie Claire Overton; Sölve Elmståhl
global_hot_topics.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To investigate the distribution and risk of thromboembolic events (TEs) among adults with and without atrial fibrillation (AF), and to assess oral anticoagulant (OAC) use over time. DESIGN: This population-based longitudinal cohort study included EpiHealth participants recruited between April 2011 and December 2016 and followed through linkage to Swedish health data registers from baseline until the first TE, death, or December 31, 2016. RESULTS: At baseline, 873 of 22,616 participants (3.9%) had AF and 297 developed incident AF during follow-up. 484 participants experienced at least one TE during 70,587 person-years. Participants with AF had higher TE incidence (68 events, 5.9%; p < 0.001), predominantly arterial (73.5%), with 94% of arterial events involving the cerebral circulation. Approximately one quarter of TEs among participants with AF occurred outside the cerebral circulation and comprised both venous and non-cerebral arterial events. Although participants with incident AF represented less than one quarter of participants with AF, they accounted for 40% of TEs in the AF group. OAC use increased from 39.0% to 50.4%, with a shift from predominantly warfarin to direct oral anticoagulants. In time-dependent Cox regression adjusted for age, sex, and prior arterial thromboembolism, untreated AF was associated with increased thromboembolic risk compared with no AF (HR 2.53), whereas OAC use was associated with lower risk. CONCLUSIONS: AF was associated with substantially increased thromboembolic risk, predominantly arterial in nature. One in five TEs among participants with AF coincided with newly diagnosed AF, suggesting potential opportunities for earlier AF detection and timely initiation of anticoagulant treatment.

global_hot_topics.title: Environmental Impact of Conventional Versus Underwater Endoscopic Mucosal Resection for Colorectal Lesions: A Procedure-Based Life Cycle Assessment With Pooled Effectiveness Estimates.
global_hot_topics.authors: Giulio Calabrese; Frederic Moll; João A Cunha Neves; Livio Bonacci; Emanuele Sinagra; Fabiana Castiglione; Marcello Maida; Eduardo Albéniz-Arbizu
global_hot_topics.abstract: OBJECTIVES: The environmental impact of endoscopic techniques remains poorly defined. We compared procedure-related environmental outcomes between conventional endoscopic mucosal resection (EMR) and underwater EMR (U-EMR) for colorectal lesions. METHODS: In this prospective pilot procedure-based life cycle assessment of the resection phase, 10-25-mm colorectal lesions underwent EMR or U-EMR across three endoscopy units. Outcomes included global warming potential (GWP, kg CO2-equivalent/procedure), waste, life-cycle water consumption, fossil resource scarcity, and terrestrial acidification. Exploratory GWP per en bloc resection was estimated using pooled randomized-trial and pilot-cohort data. RESULTS: Forty-nine procedures were included: 23 EMR and 26 U-EMR. En bloc resection was achieved in 56.5% of EMR and 69.2% of U-EMR, and R0 resection in 52.2% and 69.2%. Mean GWP was significantly lower with U-EMR than EMR (1.92 ± 0.54 vs. 2.42 ± 0.50 kg CO2-eq; p = 0.002), corresponding to a reduction of 0.50 kg CO2-eq per procedure and 50 kg CO2-eq per 100 procedures. U-EMR was associated with lower waste generation (324.0 ± 78.3 vs. 407.3 ± 72.0 g; p < 0.001), water consumption (0.56 ± 0.17 vs. 0.77 ± 0.20 m3; p < 0.001), fossil resource scarcity (0.33 ± 0.10 vs. 0.40 ± 0.09 kg oil-eq; p = 0.007), and terrestrial acidification (0.0052 ± 0.0018 vs. 0.0068 ± 0.0018 kg SO2-eq; p = 0.003). Findings were consistent across scenario and uncertainty analyses. In the meta-analysis-based model, GWP per en bloc resection was lower with U-EMR than EMR (2.59 vs. 3.51 kg CO2-eq), corresponding to a 26.3% relative reduction. CONCLUSIONS: U-EMR was associated with lower procedure-related environmental burden than conventional EMR, persisting after normalization for en bloc resection. TRIAL REGISTRATION: No. 165/26.

global_hot_topics.title: Clinical Outcomes of Partial Injection Underwater Endoscopic Mucosal Resection for Superficial Non-ampullary Duodenal Epithelial Tumors (With Video).
global_hot_topics.authors: Noboru Misawa; Takuma Higurashi; Yuki Asano; Kojiro Inoue; Hitomi Suzuki; Shigeki Tamura; Takashi Kobayashi; Michihiro Iwaki
global_hot_topics.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Although endoscopic resection is widely performed for superficial non-ampullary duodenal epithelial tumors (SNADETs), conventional endoscopic mucosal resection (CEMR) may be associated with suboptimal complete resection rates. Partial injection underwater EMR (PI-UEMR) has been proposed to improve the visualization of distal lesion margins and facilitate en bloc resection. We aimed to evaluate the outcomes of PI-UEMR for SNADETs, using CEMR as a historical institutional comparator. METHODS: This single-center observational cohort study included patients who underwent endoscopic mucosal resection for SNADETs between September 2015 and December 2025. Lesions treated with CEMR or PI-UEMR were analyzed. The primary outcomes were en bloc and R0 resection rates. The secondary outcomes included histological diagnosis and procedure-related adverse events, including intraoperative perforation, delayed perforation, and delayed bleeding. RESULTS: In total, 77 lesions in 73 patients were analyzed, including 39 treated with CEMR and 38 treated with PI-UEMR. The en bloc resection rates were 90.0% and 97.4% in the CEMR and PI-UEMR groups, respectively. The R0 resection rate was significantly higher in the PI-UEMR group than in the CEMR group (89.4% vs. 69.2%). Histological diagnoses were similar between the groups. No intraoperative perforation occurred in either group. No procedure-related adverse events, including delayed perforation or bleeding, were observed in the PI-UEMR group. CONCLUSIONS: While maintaining a favorable safety profile, PI-UEMR was associated with a higher R0 resection rate than CEMR in this study. It may represent an effective endoscopic treatment option for SNADETs, particularly when precise visualization of the distal lesion margins is required. UNLABELLED: Trial Registration: University Hospital Medical Information Network: UMIN000060637.

medical_news.title: Common drugs may help dangerous viruses spread through the body
medical_news.abstract: A surprising discovery reveals that widely used anti-inflammatory drugs may unintentionally help dangerous viruses spread through the body. Scientists found that JAK inhibitors, prescribed for rheumatoid arthritis and other inflammatory diseases, can weaken a crucial immune defense against influenza, COVID-19, and other infections.
